review:
A neon underwater slot from 2019 on 15 lines. In free spins, collecting three special symbols unlocks 10 wild spins, which gives the bonus a nice little goal.

Free spins come round often – about once every 73 spins – so it never feels slow. Medium volatility with a 2,692x max. The catch is a 94.14% RTP, well below modern standards, so enjoy it in demo for the visuals. Relaxed and atmospheric.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 73 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
